findings.title: `deleteMany` `OR` condition omits `method: WorkflowMethods.SMS` on the `retryCount` branch and causes full table scan
findings.body: In `prisma.workflowReminder.deleteMany`, the `method: WorkflowMethods.SMS` filter was moved inside only the first branch of the `OR` clause (`scheduledDate <= now`), while the second branch (`retryCount > 1`) has no `method` filter and no index on `retryCount`. Because `WorkflowReminder` only has composite indexes starting with `method`, `bookingUid`, `workflowStepId`, `seatReferenceId`, or `cancelled`, a top-level `OR` with an unindexed `retryCount > 1` branch prevents Postgres from using the `(method, scheduled, scheduledDate)` index and forces a sequential scan of the entire `WorkflowReminder` table on every cron run (and would also delete non-SMS reminders if any ever used `retryCount`). Keep `method: WorkflowMethods.SMS` at the top level of the `where` clause alongside the `OR` (or delete the reminder directly when `reminder.retryCount >= 1` in the failure handler).
